nodes.label: Chrono::Cascade Demo Programs
nodes.rationale: demo_CAS_stepfile, demo_CAS_robot and demo_CAS_profile all require run-time visualization, so the whole directory returns early unless Irrlicht or VSG is enabled; demo_CAS_converter is Irrlicht-only. OCCT portability defines (WNT on Windows, HAVE_IOSTREAM/HAVE_LIMITS_H on Unix) are applied to Chrono_cascade from inside the demo loop.
